prismara.codex.welcome.title: Welcome
prismara.codex.welcome.body:
Prismara is a refracted realm: crystal reefs floating under a living aurora, where light splits into colors and every color has a creature, a danger and a reward.
You get this Codex the first time you join a world. If you lose it, craft it with a Book and a Prismite Shard.
prismara.codex.prismite.title: Prismite
prismara.codex.prismite.body: Prismite Ore generates underground in the Overworld, glows faintly and needs an iron pickaxe or better. It drops Prismite Shards (Fortune and Silk Touch work). Nine shards craft a Block of Prismite, which glows brighter and turns back into nine shards.
prismara.codex.realm.title: The Realm
prismara.codex.realm.body: Coming soon: a dimension of floating crystal islands with a permanent aurora sky, reached through a portal built from Prismite.
prismara.codex.creatures.title: Creatures
prismara.codex.creatures.body:
Glimmerling: a gentle crystal-eared critter of meadows and flower forests. It flees when hurt.
Shardback: a hostile beast with crystal spines. Found anywhere in the Overworld; it drops Prismite Shards.
More creatures are coming, led by the Spectrum Sovereign.
prismara.codex.gear.title: Gear
prismara.codex.gear.body: Coming soon: Prismite tools and armor, and chromatic gear forged from what the Sovereign leaves behind.
